content.json:
# ISOC SecurityCaseEvents workbook

## Overview
This workbook helps SOC analysts monitor and manage investigations using **SecurityCaseEvent** data in Microsoft Defender Advanced Hunting.

This page is designed to be practical for day-to-day operations: it shows what is active now, where investigations may be slowing down, and where response follow-through needs attention.

If you're new to case analytics, think of this workbook as a guided dashboard that turns raw event history into operational signals:
- It shows your current case inventory.
- It highlights stalled investigations and overdue tasks.
- It summarizes SLA and priority posture.
- It helps you reconstruct event timelines for deeper review.

## How to use this workbook
Use this section as a simple runbook: start with context selection, then move from broad visibility to focused triage. The sequence below helps you identify risk quickly and decide where to act first.

1. Select your **Subscription** and **Advanced hunting workspace** at the top.
2. Set the **lookback days** for each section (for example, 7, 14, or 30 days).
3. Start with **Case backlog monitoring** to understand active cases.
4. Review **Stalled investigation detection** and **Overdue investigation tasks** to find action gaps.
5. Use **High-priority case monitoring** to focus on urgent work.
6. Use **Investigation timeline reconstruction** with a Case ID when you need a detailed sequence of events.

## Notes for beginners
These guidelines help explain why a panel may look empty or different from expectations, especially during first-time setup or narrow time windows.

- "No results" in a section can mean either there is no matching data in that time window, or the selected workspace does not contain that event type.
- Start with a wider window (for example, 30 days) if a section is empty.
- Use the section descriptions under each panel to understand exactly what each query is measuring.

parameters.name: HuntingWorkspaceId
parameters.label: Advanced hunting workspace
parameters.query: Resources | where type =~ "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces" | extend WorkspaceId=tostring(properties.customerId) | where isnotempty(WorkspaceId) | order by name asc | project value=WorkspaceId, label=id, group=resourceGroup

content.json:
## Case backlog monitoring

Shows the latest non-deleted case state (name, status, severity, priority, owner, type) from SecurityCaseEvent updates. Use this view as the operational inventory of active cases.

content.title: Case backlog monitoring
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let lookback = 1d * toint('{BacklogDays}');
let DeletedCases =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, IsDeleted, OperationName) by EntityId
    | where IsDeleted == true or OperationName == "Delete"
    | project CaseId = EntityId;
let CaseState =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | where OperationName in ("Create", "Update")
    | mv-expand PropertyNames, NewValues
    | extend Property = tostring(PropertyNames), Value = tostring(NewValues)
    | where Property in ("displayName", "caseStatus.statusName", "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName", "severity", "priority", "assignedTo", "caseType", "sla.status", "sla.policyName")
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, Value) by EntityId, Property
    | summarize
        CaseName = take_anyif(Value, Property == "displayName"),
        Status = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.statusName"),
        TopLevelStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName"),
        Severity = take_anyif(Value, Property == "severity"),
        Priority = take_anyif(Value, Property == "priority"),
        AssignedTo = take_anyif(Value, Property == "assignedTo"),
        CaseType = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseType"),
        SlaStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.status"),
        SlaPolicy = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.policyName")
      by CaseId = EntityId
    | join kind=leftanti DeletedCases on CaseId;CaseState
| where '{SeverityFilter}' == 'All' or Severity =~ '{SeverityFilter}'
| project CaseId, CaseName, Status, TopLevelStatus, Severity, Priority, AssignedTo, CaseType
| order by Severity asc, Priority asc, CaseName asc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["{HuntingWorkspaceId}"]}

## Stalled investigation detection

Finds cases with no recent case-event activity. It combines the selected lookback window with the inactivity threshold to highlight potential investigation drift.

content.title: Stalled investigation detection
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let lookback = 1d * toint('{StalledLookbackDays}');
let DeletedCases =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, IsDeleted, OperationName) by EntityId
    | where IsDeleted == true or OperationName == "Delete"
    | project CaseId = EntityId;
let CaseState =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | where OperationName in ("Create", "Update")
    | mv-expand PropertyNames, NewValues
    | extend Property = tostring(PropertyNames), Value = tostring(NewValues)
    | where Property in ("displayName", "caseStatus.statusName", "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName", "severity", "priority", "assignedTo", "caseType", "sla.status", "sla.policyName")
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, Value) by EntityId, Property
    | summarize
        CaseName = take_anyif(Value, Property == "displayName"),
        Status = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.statusName"),
        TopLevelStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName"),
        Severity = take_anyif(Value, Property == "severity"),
        Priority = take_anyif(Value, Property == "priority"),
        AssignedTo = take_anyif(Value, Property == "assignedTo"),
        CaseType = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseType"),
        SlaStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.status"),
        SlaPolicy = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.policyName")
      by CaseId = EntityId
    | join kind=leftanti DeletedCases on CaseId;let Threshold = toint('{InactiveDays}');
let LastActivity =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | summarize LastActivity=max(EventTime) by CaseId=EntityId;
CaseState
| join kind=leftouter LastActivity on CaseId
| extend InactiveDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), LastActivity)
| where InactiveDays >= Threshold
| project CaseId, CaseName, Status, LastActivity, InactiveDays
| order by InactiveDays desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["{HuntingWorkspaceId}"]}

## SLA compliance status distribution

Summarizes latest SLA status values captured in case events. Use this chart to spot breached, at-risk, or unknown SLA posture patterns.

content.title: SLA compliance status distribution
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let lookback = 1d * toint('{SlaLookbackDays}');
let DeletedCases =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, IsDeleted, OperationName) by EntityId
    | where IsDeleted == true or OperationName == "Delete"
    | project CaseId = EntityId;
let CaseState =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | where OperationName in ("Create", "Update")
    | mv-expand PropertyNames, NewValues
    | extend Property = tostring(PropertyNames), Value = tostring(NewValues)
    | where Property in ("displayName", "caseStatus.statusName", "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName", "severity", "priority", "assignedTo", "caseType", "sla.status", "sla.policyName")
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, Value) by EntityId, Property
    | summarize
        CaseName = take_anyif(Value, Property == "displayName"),
        Status = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.statusName"),
        TopLevelStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName"),
        Severity = take_anyif(Value, Property == "severity"),
        Priority = take_anyif(Value, Property == "priority"),
        AssignedTo = take_anyif(Value, Property == "assignedTo"),
        CaseType = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseType"),
        SlaStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.status"),
        SlaPolicy = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.policyName")
      by CaseId = EntityId
    | join kind=leftanti DeletedCases on CaseId;CaseState
| extend SlaStatus = iff(isempty(SlaStatus), "Unknown", SlaStatus)
| summarize Cases=count() by SlaStatus
| order by Cases desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["{HuntingWorkspaceId}"]}

## High-priority case monitoring

Lists current high-severity or high-priority cases so analysts can quickly focus on urgent investigations and verify assignment/status hygiene.

content.title: High-priority case monitoring
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let lookback = 1d * toint('{HighPriorityLookbackDays}');
let DeletedCases =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, IsDeleted, OperationName) by EntityId
    | where IsDeleted == true or OperationName == "Delete"
    | project CaseId = EntityId;
let CaseState =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | where OperationName in ("Create", "Update")
    | mv-expand PropertyNames, NewValues
    | extend Property = tostring(PropertyNames), Value = tostring(NewValues)
    | where Property in ("displayName", "caseStatus.statusName", "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName", "severity", "priority", "assignedTo", "caseType", "sla.status", "sla.policyName")
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, Value) by EntityId, Property
    | summarize
        CaseName = take_anyif(Value, Property == "displayName"),
        Status = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.statusName"),
        TopLevelStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName"),
        Severity = take_anyif(Value, Property == "severity"),
        Priority = take_anyif(Value, Property == "priority"),
        AssignedTo = take_anyif(Value, Property == "assignedTo"),
        CaseType = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseType"),
        SlaStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.status"),
        SlaPolicy = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.policyName")
      by CaseId = EntityId
    | join kind=leftanti DeletedCases on CaseId;CaseState
| where Severity in~ ("Critical", "High") or Priority in~ ("P0", "P1", "High")
| project CaseId, CaseName, Severity, Priority, Status, TopLevelStatus, AssignedTo
| order by Severity asc, Priority asc, CaseName asc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["{HuntingWorkspaceId}"]}

content.json:
## Overdue investigation tasks

Tracks case-task entities whose due date has passed and are not closed/completed. This helps identify execution blockers in active response workflows.

content.title: Overdue investigation tasks
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let lookback = 1d * toint('{OverdueLookbackDays}');
let TaskState =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType in ("Task", "CaseTask")
    | where OperationName in ("Create", "Update")
    | mv-expand PropertyNames, NewValues
    | extend
        EventTs = coalesce(EventTime, TimeGenerated),
        TaskId = tostring(EntityId),
        Property = tolower(tostring(PropertyNames)),
        Value = tostring(NewValues)
    | where Property in ("displayname", "taskname", "title", "status", "duedate", "caseid", "casename")
    | summarize arg_max(EventTs, Value) by TaskId, Property
    | summarize
        TaskName = take_anyif(Value, Property in ("displayname", "taskname", "title")),
        TaskStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "status"),
        DueDateRaw = take_anyif(Value, Property == "duedate"),
        CaseId = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseid"),
        CaseName = take_anyif(Value, Property == "casename")
      by TaskId
    | extend
        DueDate = todatetime(DueDateRaw),
        CaseId = iff(isempty(CaseId), TaskId, CaseId),
        CaseName = iff(isempty(CaseName), CaseId, CaseName),
        TaskName = iff(isempty(TaskName), "(unnamed task)", TaskName)
    | where isnotnull(DueDate)
    | where DueDate < now()
    | where isempty(TaskStatus) or TaskStatus !in~ ("Closed", "Completed", "Done", "Resolved")
    | project CaseId, CaseName, TaskId, TaskName, DueDate, TaskStatus
    | order by DueDate asc;
let ResultCount = toscalar(TaskState | count);
union
(TaskState),
(print CaseId="", CaseName="No overdue tasks found in selected lookback", TaskId="", TaskName="", DueDate=datetime(null), TaskStatus="" | where ResultCount == 0)","selectedWorkspaceIds":["{HuntingWorkspaceId}"]}

## Case workload distribution by owner

Counts active cases by owner from latest case state. Use this to rebalance queue pressure and identify unassigned work.

content.title: Case workload distribution by owner
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let lookback = 1d * toint('{WorkloadLookbackDays}');
let DeletedCases =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, IsDeleted, OperationName) by EntityId
    | where IsDeleted == true or OperationName == "Delete"
    | project CaseId = EntityId;
let CaseState =
    SecurityCaseEvent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | where EntityType == "Case"
    | where OperationName in ("Create", "Update")
    | mv-expand PropertyNames, NewValues
    | extend Property = tostring(PropertyNames), Value = tostring(NewValues)
    | where Property in ("displayName", "caseStatus.statusName", "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName", "severity", "priority", "assignedTo", "caseType", "sla.status", "sla.policyName")
    | summarize arg_max(EventTime, Value) by EntityId, Property
    | summarize
        CaseName = take_anyif(Value, Property == "displayName"),
        Status = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.statusName"),
        TopLevelStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseStatus.topLevelStatusName"),
        Severity = take_anyif(Value, Property == "severity"),
        Priority = take_anyif(Value, Property == "priority"),
        AssignedTo = take_anyif(Value, Property == "assignedTo"),
        CaseType = take_anyif(Value, Property == "caseType"),
        SlaStatus = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.status"),
        SlaPolicy = take_anyif(Value, Property == "sla.policyName")
      by CaseId = EntityId
    | join kind=leftanti DeletedCases on CaseId;CaseState
| extend Owner = iff(isempty(AssignedTo), "Unassigned", AssignedTo)
| summarize ActiveCases=count() by Owner
| order by ActiveCases desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["{HuntingWorkspaceId}"]}

content.json:
## Investigation timeline reconstruction

Provides a chronological event trail for a selected case ID (or all cases). Use this to reconstruct actions, updates, and case transitions.

content.title: Investigation timeline reconstruction
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let lookback = 1d * toint('{TimelineLookbackDays}');
SecurityCaseEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| where EntityType == "Case"
| where isempty('{CaseFilter}') or tostring(EntityId) == '{CaseFilter}'
| project EventTime, CaseId=tostring(EntityId), OperationName, IsDeleted, PropertyNames, NewValues, TimeGenerated
| order by EventTime asc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["{HuntingWorkspaceId}"]}
